_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: Ready to export in MindMax Write

description: Turn a long text into an image carousel (cover, one idea per card, charts and infographics, closing card) and give the user a one-click link to it in MindMax Write (mindmax.me/write), where they export the cards as images for Xiaohongshu / Instagram / LinkedIn or publish them as a card page. Call it when the user wants an article, notes or a report turned into cards, slides-like images, a carousel or a 小红书 post, or mentions MindMax. First call get_mindmax_diagram_guide with type "cards" for the card-draft format, write the draft, and pass the text it is drawn from as `source_text`; the result reports numbers and quotes that do not match it. Show the returned link verbatim. Nothing is uploaded: everything is packed into the link (URL fragment).

draft.description: The complete card draft in Markdown: the `<!-- mm:story … -->` line, then each card starting with `<!-- mm:card <type> -->`, with `<!-- mm:src … -->` lines quoting source_text.

source_text.description: The text the cards are drawn from, verbatim. Every quote and every number on the cards is checked against it; it is not put on the cards.

title.description: Title; defaults to the cover heading

name: open_cards_in_mindmax

url.description: Link that opens the cards in MindMax Write

title: Open cards in MindMax Write
